digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery and close gate
propositions: A ticket whose context exceeds 24,000 chars is refused by bounded recovery before any model call, blocking correct merged work from reaching closed status without --force-close.
The context limit (24,000 chars) is incoherent with the criteria limit (32,000 chars), allowing criteria sets that pass all criteria bounds but then fail the context bound.

A completion verifier failure due to step-budget exhaustion falsely reports 'install the agents extra' remedy instead of the exception's own diagnostic, because recovery_failure_cause returns None for CompletionRecoveryError.
Raising the context cap to 100,000 chars and eliding nothing covers observed large tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) while maintaining the fail-closed cost safeguard of zero billable calls on breach.
Compaction alternatives (dropping comment history, deriving from model window tokens) were evaluated and rejected as introducing signed-false-PASS vectors or unit errors.
The remedy selection must be based on exception cause rather than type to distinguish genuine model unavailability from step-budget exhaustion that already ran the verifier.
